scope: Historical Level01Polish_v01 implementation and its recorded build, tests and runtime probe. This is not acceptance of later VRWeaponPolish changes or the complete GDD.

physical_opening.scope: One live AI and scripted CharacterMovement/StartDesktopSlash. Other owned AI paused; no player heals, teleports, direct resolver calls or damage edits inside this phase.
physical_opening.input: Scripted AddMovementInput and StartDesktopSlash, actual CharacterMovement and native blade sweeps; not human control.

post_observation_resource_reset.note: This unconditional reset follows the live observation and precedes further rule tests. No-heal-during-observation does not mean the whole run had no resource intervention.

mixed_ai.spawn_observation_scope: Counter delta only during live mixed AI observation; earlier isolated-wave retries are excluded. If all wave actors were already spawned at entry, this window is not a spawning-performance sample.

runtime.later_stage_rule_test_scope: Explicit entry teleports; most AI paused; direct real Resolver contacts use unchanged ordinary melee definition and normal protection intervals. This is rule integration, not a continuous normal-input playthrough.

bexit_floor_fixture.scope: Explicit low-currency scalar fixture before actual Bexit entry. Existing 46 defeat IDs are retained. Six ordinary deaths must add six currency; the boundary floor must add no currency.

source_scope: Saved gameplay map with temporary Test.Level01 identity; main profile is never used.
Opening movement uses AddMovementInput and real collision/CharacterMovement; attack uses StartDesktopSlash and native blade sweeps against one live sword AI.
Opening automation is not human input. Other opening enemies are paused to isolate the probe.
Later stage entries are explicit teleports and most AI is paused. Defeats use the unchanged ordinary player melee attack definition through genuine resolver contacts.
The multiplier probe uses an explicitly labelled 10-damage fixture, not lethal 999 damage. A 100-damage enemy contact produces the retry test death.
Bcourt wave 3 includes a bounded live mixed melee/ranged observation. Protective health restores, if necessary, are reported.
Natural LingQi accumulation is verified to 40/level 2. Before Bexit, an explicit low-LingQi fixture tests the authored level-end floor without granting currency.
No claim of manual continuous completion, seven-minute pacing, headset/controller acceptance or VR performance.
